verify_detail: asses ~3/5" symptom reported. If the UI test doesn\'t `pm clear` (or reinstall) the app before each run, whether it lands on a "skip" launch depends purely on how many cold starts have accumulated since the last data wipe, which explains why it looks random across CI runs. Fix: either have the test force-clear app data before every run and always expect the button on launch #1, or make the test assert against the actual `Sync unavailable` state rather than assuming the button is always present.'
